name: Al-Santa

queries.query: Al-Santa Egypt cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) official services page and its digital-map and historical-city-map services. Search did not expose an anonymous Al-Santa parcel feature layer or parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint.

queries.query: السنتا مصر خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي بوابة رسمية
queries.result: First-party Arabic discovery identified ESA services for digital maps, cadastral/state-property mapping, and historical maps, plus an ESA notice about a mapping/data-modernization protocol with Gharbia Governorate. No public anonymous Al-Santa parcel geometry or safe parcel identity was exposed.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Arabic first-party discovery, followed by bounded TLS-verified GET inspection of official ESA pages. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement.

portalsFound.observation: Official Egyptian Survey Authority services catalogue lists digital maps, historical maps, coordinate certificates, boundary separation, and state-property encroachment survey services. This is national agency evidence, not a public parcel API.

Official ESA notice records a protocol with Gharbia Governorate to inventory and validate state property, prepare accurate survey maps, and digitize the data. It supports local service custody/context but does not publish an anonymous Al-Santa parcel layer.

Official ESA historical-city-map page exposes governorate/centre/district selectors and map catalogue results, but the initial public GET showed Cairo defaults and no anonymous Al-Santa parcel feature response.

requests.assessment: Successful TLS-verified GET. Service catalogue inspected; no parcel schema, CRS, stable parcel identity, or geometry response.

Successful TLS-verified GET. Current HTML exposes server-side governorate/centre/district selectors and historical map catalogue UI; no Al-Santa selection response or parcel feature service was requested because no public endpoint was disclosed.
Successful TLS-verified GET. Page describes purchasing digital GIS/CAD/PDF/orthophoto maps and requesting projection/layers; it is not an anonymous parcel download/API.
Successful TLS-verified GET. Gharbia-specific ESA/Governorate protocol notice inspected as local custody evidence; no geometry or safe parcel attributes returned.
